text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Brentford and Burnley at the Gtech Community Stadium!

Brentford haven't hit the heights that they managed to last season, after winning just one of their matches in all competitions so far (D5 L4), which was a 3-0 victory over Fulham in the second weekend of the Premier League.
The Bees are currently winless in their last eight outings (D4 L4) and come into this on the back of a heartbreaking last-minute 2-1 defeat to Manchester United last time out.
Burnley are also struggling so far this season, having just one win on the board in the league since their promotion (D1 L6), and find themselves in the relegation zone.
That lone victory came in their last away match though as they beat Luton Town 2-1 at Kenilworth Road but followed that up with a heavy 4-1 defeat to Chelsea just before the international break.
ThomasFrank makes three changes to the side that lost to Manchester United last time out.
Flekken has recovered from illness to start in goal, with Onyeka and Maupay also coming in.
Strakosha and Roerslev start on the bench, as does Mee after recovering from a calf injury.
Aaron Hickey is suspended after getting his fifth booking of the season in that game.
Vincent Kompany also makes three changes from their defeat to Chelsea two weeks ago as Roberts, O'Shea and Amdouni are all brought in.
Delcroix and Brownhill drop to the bench, where Redmond is also named after returning from injury.
Vitinho isn't included in the squad.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Amdouni gets the game under way for Burnley!
CHANCE! Norgaard wins an early free-kick, and Jensen takes it quickly, sliding it into the right of the box for Maupay.
He meets it first time but drills his shot wide of the far post.
Brentford have made a bright start to this game, and they're putting a lot of early pressure on Burnley.
Mbeumo looks to thread it forward for Jensen this time, but the Dane just sets off too early.
It's better from Burnley here as they enjoy their first spell of possession.
Trafford lifts it forward for Foster, who breezes past Onyeka before being stopped in his tracks by Norgaard.
NO GOAL! Mbeumo curls a deep free-kick into the far post and Collins stretches out a leg to volley it back across the face of goal.
Maupay makes a late run across to turn it in from close range, but the flag goes up.
VAR is having a look at this...
There were two Brentford players standing offside when the teams lined up for the free-kick, but it looked like Collins had timed his run.
VAR agrees with the linesman that there was an offside in there and the onfield decision stands.
CLOSE! Burnley manage to pass their way through Brentford's compact midfield, and Tresor has a run down the right before cutting inside.
He has a go from just outside the box, but drills his low shot wide of the near post.
Brentford won their last league game against Burnley 2-0 in May 2022, ending a run of four straight defeats against them.
They last won back-to-back meetings with the Clarets in December 1996.
It's a poor pass out from the back by Pinnock as he gifts it straight to Tresor.
There's no space down the right, so he switches out to the left before trying to lift a cross in, but it's cleared.
Three players are down here - Mbeumo was caught and the ball smacked Jensen in the face before Roberts hurt himself sliding in to block a run.
All three are back on their feet without needing treatment though.
SAVE! It's cushioned out to Mbeumo on the right, and he floats a great cross into the middle where Onyeka has a completely free header.
He can't generate any power in his header though, and it's a comfortable save for Trafford.
Burnley are asking for a penalty here as Tresor went down in the box under a challenge from Onyeka.
It looked like the Nigerian lost his footing and slipped over, causing the trip to happen, and the referee waves play on.
Brentford are just starting to up the pressure again here as they push higher upfield.
They're switching it from side to side in an attempt to open up Burnley.
GREAT BLOCK! Mbeumo's cross is half-cleared, and Janelt keeps it alive on the far side.
The ball pinballs through the crowd before Norgaard stretches to volley a shot on goal, and O'Shea is in the right place to make the block.
WIDE! There's a nervy moment at the back for Burnley as it's played back to Trafford, and he doesn't see Wissa closing him down.
The forward slides in to block the pass, but it flies just wide of the post to the keeper's relief.
WISSA SCORES! Brentford win it back in midfield again and Maupay threads it into Mbeumo down the right of the box.
He plays it straight back across goal to the far post, and it's got just enough weight on it to find Wissa, who is left with a simple tap-in.
1-0 Brentford!
It's a brilliant throughball into Mbeumo, but he doesn't even need to glance up to know Wissa is in support - the low cross is perfectly-weighted between Al Dakhil and Trafford.
Burnley have looked really shaky at the back in the last few minutes and they just can't keep hold of the ball when they try to advance over the halfway line.
SAVED AND OFF THE LINE! There's another mix-up at the back as Al Dakhil is caught on the ball by Wissa.
He touches it into Maupay, whose low shot is only half-dealt with by Trafford and O'Shea races back to clear it off the line.
GOOD SAVE! Brentford are truly on top now and Mbeumo has space down the right again.
When he isn't closed down, he cuts inside and goes for goal himself, firing towards the near post, but Trafford pushes it away.
Onyeka pushes his way past Berge, who drags him back by his shirt.
He's shown the first yellow card of the game.
Brentford win another corner and it's whipped in by Jensen.
Ajer rises highest at the near post to flick it on, but Collins can't react quick enough at the back to get something on it.
It's better from Burnley here as Tresor bundles it forward before picking out Cullen's run down the left.
He helps it onto Roberts, who clips it in from the byline, but Collins clears it in the middle.
Foster pulls it back to Odobert, who opens up a pocket of space when he checks back onto his right foot.
He curls a shot towards the far post, but doesn't test Flekken as it flies wide.
Mbeumo is getting a lot of joy down Brentford's right side and he gets the better of two more Burnley players as he breezes down the wing.
He does too much in the end though, losing control at the byline.
GOOD SAVE! Trafford doesn't get any distance on his punch as he stops it from reaching Onyeka, and Mbeumo keeps it alive on the edge of the box.
Norgaard drills a shot which deflects off Wissa, and Trafford reacts quickly to get a strong hand to it.
Roberts is complaining that it should've been a Burnley throw-in, and he's booked for dissent.
GREAT SAVE! Again, Burnley don't deal with the ball into the box, and Maupay does well to hold off O'Shea as he spins before scooping a shot towards goals.
It's always rising, but Trafford still has to dive to tip it over the crossbar.
Burnley win their first corner of the game, but it's a poor delivery from Tresor as it hits the first man.
Norgaard clears his lines, but the Clarets quickly win it back.
GOOD SAVE! Burnley quickly work it to the edge of the box and Amdouni is completely unmarked.
He hits his shot first time whipping it around the defender in front of him, but Flekken reacts quickly to push it wide.
Cullen has two attempts at clipping Wissa's heels, succeeding the second time.
He's not happy with the free-kick, and he's booked for dissent.
HALF-TIME: BRENTFORD 1-0 BURNLEY.
Wissa's goal gives Brentford a 1-0 advantage over Burnley at half-time.
The Bees had a great first half and thought they'd taken the lead early on through Maupay, though his goal was ruled out for an offside in the build-up.
Brentford kept the pressure on though and Mbeumo set Wissa up for a close-range tap-in 25 minutes in.
Trafford has made big saves to deny all of the hosts' front three, while Flekken was alert to keep out Amdouni's whipped effort just before the break.
Thomas Frank will be pleased with that first half and will be hoping they can keep it up in the second half.
Mbeumo, in particular, has looked dangerous and it looks like the hosts have more goals in them.
Burnley had a few bright moments, but have looked quite shaky at the back.
Kompany will be looking for a way to get them back into the game, while also steadying them at the back.
Burnley are making a change at the break as they look to get back into this game.
Odobert goes off, with Koleosho on in his place.
Brentford get us back under way for the second half!
Koleosho has the beating of Ajer, and the right-back's last attempt at catching him is to slide in.
He's booked for the challenge.
Mbeumo makes another driving run into the box, but he's closed down by O'Shea and Trafford before he can pick out a cross.
He goes to ground under the pressure but doesn't get the penalty he's asking for.
Burnley have made a much better start to the second half and they're keeping Brentford under pressure here.
Tresor puts the latest cross into the box and Ajer glances it out just ahead of Koleosho.
CHANCE! It's a poor bit of control by Pinnock as he gifts the ball to Amdouni on the edge of his own box.
He spins before firing a shot on goal, but it's always rising and doesn't test Flekken.
Onyeka is late getting across to Amdouni, and just steps across his path.
He picks up a yellow card.
Brentford are trying to regain some of their first-half control here, but they're struggling to get out of their own half.
Burnley are closing them down much quicker and closing down the channels well.
This time, Norgaard manages to get a long ball forward and Ajer is unmarked as he chases it down the right.
He pulls it back from the byline, fizzing it into a dangerous area, but nobody's there for Brentford.
The hosts are just starting to ease back into the game here as Burnley start to drop deeper.
It's patient play from Brentford as they work it out from the back.
Thomas Frank is complaining about a foul on Mbeumo that wasn't picked up and it's caught the referee's attention.
He's booked for dissent.
MBEUMO SCORES! It's Onyeka that drags Brentford forward down the right this time, and he squares it into the box.
Ajer helps it onto Maupay, who cushions it into Mbeumo.
He gets it out of his feet before curling a lovely effort past Trafford and into the top corner.

events.action: curling a lovely effort past Trafford

text: 2-0 Brentford!
Maupay has his back to goal when it's laid off to him, but he sees Mbeumo in space, so cushions it into his path to set up the goal.
BLOCK! It's a lovely spin from Jensen between two Burnley defenders before he squares it into the box.
Maupay drags Trafford off his line, but the keeper pushes it to Jensen.
He's rushed into his shot by Al Dakhil and he blazes it over the bar.
Burnley are making a double change as they look for a way back into this game.
Tresor is the first to go off, with Bruun Larsen on for him.
And Berge is also taken off, with Brownhill replacing him.
Trafford is down receiving treatment for what looks like a knee injury.
The physios are taking their time going through the checks, but the keeper is going to carry on.
Jensen just pushes Brownhill off the ball, and then walks away with it to prevent the quick free-kick.
He's booked for time-wasting.
It's better from Burnley and their pressure results in them winning a corner.
Their crosses into the box have been letting them down though, and this is no different as Pinnock clears.
Brentford win it back high upfield once more and Maupay is slipped through by Norgaard.
He hits his shot straight against Taylor, and a loose touch prevents him from getting a second bite at it.
WHAT A CHANCE! Burnley break quickly on the counter, and Foster surges down the left.
Five Brentford players and the keeper get drawn towards him so he squares it to Koleosho, who has an open goal to aim for, but he scuffs at the chance.

text: Brentford are making their first changes now.
Jensen is going off for Yarmolyuk.
And Ajer also makes way, with Roerslev replacing him.
There's a change for Burnley too as Redmond comes on for Amdouni.
ROBERTS IS OFF! Flekken goes long over the top to try and pick out Wissa's run off the back of Roberts.
It's a clumsy challenge from the right-back as he has a handful of the winger's shirt as he wrestles him down.
He's saying he got the ball, but it's not going to stop him from being shown a second yellow card.
Burnley are down to 10 men!
The resulting free-kick is taken by Mbeumo, and he curls his shot around the outside of the wall.
It's too close to Trafford though, and he holds onto it comfortably.
Bruun Larsen, who only came onto the pitch 15 minutes ago is having to be sacrificed for another defender here as Delcroix is brought on.
Burnley are enjoying a good spell of possession here, though it's all in front of Brentford.
They're patiently working it forward, trying to draw the hosts out of their compact shape.
Third change for Brentford now, and it's Ghoddos that's coming on for Onyeka.
Janelt is late getting across to Redmond, and picks up a late yellow card.
GHODDOS SCORES! And what a goal it is! Wissa and Norgaard link up well down the left, with the Dane clipping a cross into the middle.
Al Dakhil heads it clear but only gets it as far as Ghoddos.
He brings it down on his chest and takes on the shot from distance.
It swerves away from Trafford and goes in off the inside of the far post.
3-0 Brentford!
Brentford are making their final change following that goal.
Maupay is taken off, with Olakigbe replacing him.
CHANCE! There's another nervy moment at the back for Burnley as Trafford's pass is picked off by Norgaard.
He unselfishly tries to square it to Wissa, but that gives Trafford a chance to atone as he quickly gets down to cut it out.
Janelt's cross is only half-cleared by Delcroix and it falls to Ghoddos on the edge of the box once more.
He can't recreate his goal though as he slices this shot high into the stands.
Ghoddos picks up a late booking for his mistimed tackle.
Brentford are still looking to add to their tally here as it's lifted over the top towards Ghoddos.
He's off balance and goes skidding across the slick surface as Brownhill clears his lines.
Delcroix's attempted pass is straight at Norgaard, and the rebound off him falls at Mbeumo's feet.
He takes it to the byline before looping a cross in, but nobody in the box can get near it.
FULL-TIME: BRENTFORD 3-0 BURNLEY.
Brentford get back to winning ways as they cruise to a 3-0 victory over 10-man Burnley.
Maupay thought he'd given the Bees the lead inside 10 minutes, only for it to be chalked out for an offside in the build-up.
Wissa did get them in front though, tapping in from close range.
Trafford kept his side in the game, but a wonderful curling strike from Mbeumo eventually beat him just after the hour mark.
Roberts was sent off for two yellow cards, leaving Burnley to finish the game with 10 men, and Ghoddos came on to rifle an excellent swerving shot in off the post to round things off.
That win lifts Brentford up to 14th in the table and they travel to Chelsea next time out.
Burnley stay in the relegation zone and travel to fellow strugglers Bournemouth next weekend.
That's all for today, goodbye!
